verdicts.reason: Both crop the model's face to a half-sliver on the right edge, so the hero image and the original's balance are largely lost. The blue panel nearly fills the width and pushes the face off the edge. The panel's small text (Online Workshop, FREE JOIN) is also tiny in a 160px column. A sits its panel lower, so the eye, nose and lips stay visible, although its bottom margin is tight. B raises the panel so its right edge covers the lips, which hides even more of the face; B's only edge is a more centred vertical position.
